products.name: Vidu (Tsinghua / Shengshu)
products.note: Video generation model; academic spin-off; cross-border data review advised

reading.body:
Shengshu Technology operates Vidu, a Chinese video generation model spun from Tsinghua University that converts text prompts, images, and reference videos into video output. This positions the company in the emerging video synthesis category, where input-to-output latency and compute efficiency matter as much as output quality.

Video generation is compute-intensive. The model must encode visual semantics, maintain temporal coherence across frames, and produce broadcast-quality output. Whether through text, image, or video conditioning, Vidu's three modes each demand substantial inference compute. The platform's target users—creators and advertisers working at scale—will drive demand for fast iteration cycles, which directly pressure the underlying infrastructure.

The academic origin and Tsinghua affiliation signal access to research talent and datasets, but tell nothing about the infrastructure Vidu runs on, its power footprint, or whether it operates domestically or through cross-border servers. The data flags that cross-border data review is advised, indicating regulatory complexity around user uploads, but does not specify hosting location, power sources, or scaling constraints. For a site whose thesis centers on buildings and power as binding constraints, these details remain opaque.

profile_text.body:
Shengshu Technology is a Chinese AI company that operates Vidu, an AI video generation platform accessible at vidu.studio. The company describes Vidu as a tool that transforms text prompts, images, and reference videos into high-quality video output, supporting three core creation modes: Text to Video, Image to Video, and Reference to Video. The site positions the product for a range of users, from independent creators producing social media content to businesses using it for marketing and commercial advertising, including animating product images and altering ad backgrounds.

Vidu is tracked as a video generation model with an academic connection, noted as a spin-off associated with Tsinghua University. The held facts flag that cross-border data review is advised for users of the product, which is relevant given the platform handles uploaded user content. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for Shengshu Technology at this time.
